resources.string: Text your friends and call for help even when the network goes down. Messages hop from phone to phone over Bluetooth.
This app doesn’t replace 112: reports go to the festival staff. In an emergency, call 112 if you can.
It’s how your friends see you. No account, no phone number.
What we ask for and why
The network is made of the phones of the people around you. For it to work, the app asks for:
So your phone can find the phones around you and pass messages along.
On this Android version, Bluetooth can’t search for phones without the location permission.
We ask for the camera and location only when you need them.
We ask for the camera only when you need it.
Add your friends while you’re together: one of you scans the other’s code, and that’s it. Then you can text without signal.
The network grows with everyone around who has Ping Up.
